thread:
sara-support: FYI customer (AcmeLabs, org_id=org_3k2f) opened a ticket — Token Cost dashboard shows $0 / NaN for several days. Link: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/org_3k2f/costs (screenshot attached).

sara-support: They say billing invoices show normal charges, only the console tiles show zeros and a few NaNs.

miguel-engineering: Assigning — can you paste a quick repro query (from warehouse) so I can see if ledger rows exist?

sara-support: Ran quick check: `SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM billing.events WHERE org_id='org_3k2f' AND ts >= '2026-03-10'` -> returns 123.45, so raw billing rows exist. Dashboard query must be producing zeros/NaN downstream.

priya-data: I'll check the billing-aggregator job and the join to model-prices. Seen zeros when price lookup returns NULL. Running `kubectl logs -l app=billing-aggregator | grep org_3k2f` now.

priya-data: log snippet: `WARN 2026-03-14T03:12:21Z price_lookup returned NULL for model_variant=gptx-7b org=org_3k2f` — looks promising as root cause.

miguel-engineering: Is the dashboard computing cost as `tokens * price_per_token` or using cost_usd directly? If it's computing, and price is NULL -> multiply -> NULL/NaN, then aggregation/metrics pipeline might coerce to 0 in some places.

aj-oncall: Quick triage: if price field name changed in model-prices service (schema mismatch) our join will fail. Can someone check recent deployments to platform-prices?

priya-data: Confirmed: platform-prices rolled out v2 yesterday. API contract changed: `price_per_token` renamed to `price_per_unit`. Our billing-aggregator still selects `price_per_token`. That returns NULL -> downstream divide/multiply produced NaN in summary job.

miguel-engineering: Ok — two-step: 1) Patch aggregator to coalesce(new/old names), default to a safe fallback 2) Backfill naive days where price was NULL. I'll open a small PR.

aj-oncall: I can deploy a hotfix to staging now. For backfill we can run `python tools/backfill_costs.py --org org_3k2f --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-16`. That will re-run the aggregator for that org/time range. ETA ~ 60-120m depending on backlog.

sara-support: Customer wants ETA and whether other orgs impacted. Any quick way to list all orgs with NULL price hits?

priya-data: Running warehouse query: `SELECT DISTINCT org_id FROM billing.aggregator_errors WHERE reason LIKE '%price_lookup returned NULL%'` -> returns 12 orgs, including org_3k2f. I'll add them to backfill queue.

miguel-engineering: PR opened: `fix/price-coalesce` — changes join to `COALESCE(price_per_token, price_per_unit)` and adds `GREATEST(0.000001, price)` guard to avoid divide-by-zero. Unit tests + integration query added.

deploy-bot: CI passed for fix/price-coalesce (build 4521).

aj-oncall: Deploying fix to staging then prod canary. I'll run backfill once canary looks stable.

:sparkles: aj-oncall: Canary in prod looks good — no increased error rate in billing-aggregator. Kicking off backfill for the 12 affected orgs now. Backfill command: `./bin/agg-backfill --org-file /tmp/affected_orgs.txt --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-16 --concurrency 4`

aj-oncall: Backfill progress: 3/12 complete (ETA ~90m).

:sheepish: sara-support: Passing ETA to customer — they acknowledged, asked to be notified when their dashboard is OK.

aj-oncall: Backfill finished for org_3k2f. I verified dashboard tiles — values restored, no NaNs.

priya-data: Following up — created ENG-1234 to make model-prices contract explicit and add schema compatibility tests in platform-prices and billing-aggregator. Owner: platform-prices team.

miguel-engineering: Merged PR and released to prod. Monitoring queued to detect any further NULL price occurrences and auto-fallback.

aj-oncall: Notifying customer and closing support ticket.

sara-support: Customer confirmed dashboard is normal. Closing the case. Added postmortem note to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1234

priya-data: Also scheduling a short postmortem sync with platform-prices and data infra to prevent recurrence.

aj-oncall: Marking thread resolved. :thumbsup:
